lines.text: A peace offering may be eaten on the day of sacrifice or the next day; leftovers on day three are burned.
Israel must leave the edges of the field and the fallen grapes for the priests.
God tells Israel to rebuke a neighbor directly, seek no revenge or grudge, and love their neighbor as themselves.
Fruit from newly planted trees is forbidden for seven years, praise offered in year four, and may be eaten in year five.
